exposure: Group A: Pruritus without elevated liver enzymes and bilirubin
Group C: Pruritus and elevated bile acids (regardless of liver enzyme levels)
Group B: Pruritus, elevated liver enzymes, and bilirubin
finding: While there were significant differences in weight gain during pregnancy, liver enzyme levels, and gestational age at delivery between the groups, there was no significant difference in the mode of delivery.
mod_finding: There was no statistically significant variation in the mode of delivery between groups.
